title: Asymptotics for Bivariate Risk Models with Random-Size Clusters of Dependent Claims
summary: This paper investigates finite-horizon tail and ruin asymptotics for models with random-size clusters of dependent main and delayed claims under Levy investments. Under long-tailed, dominatedly varying claim distributions, a conditional, uniformly weighted Ko-Tang condition within clusters, and moment conditions, univariate asymptotics are derived for discounted aggregate claims and ruin probabilities.
